Research OS 1.1.0 contains 39 catalogued skills.

## Orchestrators

| Skill | Invocation | Leading concept | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`ask-research`](../skills/orchestrators/ask-research/SKILL.md) | user | route | Route a research task to the right Research OS workflow. |
| [`develop-research`](../skills/orchestrators/develop-research/SKILL.md) | user | adaptive loop | Develop a topic, direction, problem, source, or partial idea through adaptive interviewing, evidence research, reviewer attack, and repair until it becomes a verified Research Brief and the requested research plan, proposal, project brief, paper blueprint, or manuscript draft. |
| [`setup-research-os`](../skills/orchestrators/setup-research-os/SKILL.md) | user | contract | Initialize a project with the durable Research OS workspace contract. |
| [`grill-research-idea`](../skills/orchestrators/grill-research-idea/SKILL.md) | user | decision tree | Interrogate a research idea one decision at a time until it is researchable. |
| [`idea-triage`](../skills/orchestrators/idea-triage/SKILL.md) | user | verdict | Classify research ideas as kill, repair, pilot, or advance. |
| [`research-wayfinder`](../skills/orchestrators/research-wayfinder/SKILL.md) | user | fog | Map a multi-session research effort as decisions that progressively clear the fog. |
| [`to-research-brief`](../skills/orchestrators/to-research-brief/SKILL.md) | user | collapse | Collapse the current discussion and evidence into a rigorous research brief. |
| [`to-research-plan`](../skills/orchestrators/to-research-plan/SKILL.md) | user | execution case | Convert a verified Research Brief into an executable academic research plan. |
| [`to-workpackages`](../skills/orchestrators/to-workpackages/SKILL.md) | user | tracer study | Split a research brief into dependency-aware tracer workpackages. |
| [`execute-workpackage`](../skills/orchestrators/execute-workpackage/SKILL.md) | user | claim | Claim and execute one eligible research workpackage with bounded authority, falsification gates, receipts, and readback. |
| [`to-paper-draft`](../skills/orchestrators/to-paper-draft/SKILL.md) | user | argument | Draft an academic paper from verified research artifacts. |
| [`to-proposal`](../skills/orchestrators/to-proposal/SKILL.md) | user | fundability | Turn a research design into a grant, institutional, or project proposal. |
| [`research-handoff`](../skills/orchestrators/research-handoff/SKILL.md) | user | continuity | Create a verifiable handoff that preserves research continuity across sessions. |

## Primitives

| Skill | Invocation | Leading concept | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`research-grilling`](../skills/primitives/research-grilling/SKILL.md) | model | decision tree | Resolve a research decision tree through one-question-at-a-time interviewing. Use when a research question, plan, construct, mechanism, scope, or trade-off is ambiguous; when the user asks to be grilled; or when another research workflow needs human decisions separated from discoverable facts. |
| [`research-workspace-contract`](../skills/primitives/research-workspace-contract/SKILL.md) | model | contract | Establish, resolve, and verify the durable Research OS workspace contract without overwriting existing work. Use when an explicitly authorized research workflow needs canonical context, decisions, evidence, briefs, outputs, handoffs, templates, or adapter paths initialized or repaired. |
| [`artifact-reconciliation`](../skills/primitives/artifact-reconciliation/SKILL.md) | model | intent | Resolve conflicting canonical research artifacts into one verified current state without erasing either intent or provenance. Use when briefs, decisions, claims, methods, datasets, protocols, handoffs, revisions, or schema versions disagree and a downstream workflow cannot safely choose between them. |
| [`research-domain-modeling`](../skills/primitives/research-domain-modeling/SKILL.md) | model | construct | Build and sharpen a research domain model. Use when constructs, variables, mechanisms, units, estimands, or field-specific terms are ambiguous; when a decision should be recorded; or when another research workflow needs the project vocabulary and research context maintained. |
| [`evidence-research`](../skills/primitives/evidence-research/SKILL.md) | model | claim chain | Trace research claims to high-trust primary sources and record an auditable claim chain. Use when a literature fact, dataset property, method claim, novelty claim, citation, or external factual premise must be verified rather than recalled. |
| [`literature-landscape`](../skills/primitives/literature-landscape/SKILL.md) | model | map | Map a literature into theories, mechanisms, methods, data, findings, and disputes. Use when the user needs a literature landscape, research stream map, conceptual synthesis, boundary search, or an evidence-backed view of what a field already knows. |
| [`gap-audit`](../skills/primitives/gap-audit/SKILL.md) | model | difference | Audit whether a claimed research gap is real, material, and defensible. Use when a topic is said to be novel, underexplored, first, missing, or different; when a reviewer could dismiss the gap as relabeling; or before writing a contribution claim. |
| [`contribution-design`](../skills/primitives/contribution-design/SKILL.md) | model | delta | Design a defensible contribution delta against the closest literature. Use when a research idea needs theoretical, empirical, measurement, identification, data, or predictive contribution claims; when novelty exists but significance is unclear; or when a reviewer asks what the paper changes. |
| [`design-research-three-ways`](../skills/primitives/design-research-three-ways/SKILL.md) | model | contrast | Generate and compare three genuinely different research designs under shared constraints. Use when the first design may be anchoring the project, when theory-first, identification-first, and data-first alternatives should be contrasted, or when a design choice needs independent parallel exploration. |
| [`theory-builder`](../skills/primitives/theory-builder/SKILL.md) | model | mechanism | Build a theory from mechanisms, actors, incentives, frictions, boundary conditions, and discriminating predictions. Use when a paper needs a conceptual framework, propositions, causal chain, competing mechanisms, or economic meaning before equations or methods are chosen. |
| [`construct-design`](../skills/primitives/construct-design/SKILL.md) | model | measurement | Define constructs and defensible measurement models. Use when abstract concepts must become variables, proxies, scales, indices, labels, or latent measures; when construct validity is at risk; or when measurement choices could create the finding. |
| [`equation-builder`](../skills/primitives/equation-builder/SKILL.md) | model | semantics | Derive and audit research equations so every symbol, operator, unit, assumption, boundary condition, and limiting case has economic meaning. Use for mathematical models, PDEs, stochastic processes, optimization, estimators, or when a borrowed equation risks being only an analogy. |
| [`identification-design`](../skills/primitives/identification-design/SKILL.md) | model | counterfactual | Design identification around an estimand and credible counterfactual. Use when a study makes causal, mechanism, transmission, treatment, policy, or structural claims; when endogeneity, selection, simultaneity, measurement error, or non-synchronous timing threatens inference; or when predictive evidence is being confused with causal evidence. |
| [`data-feasibility`](../skills/primitives/data-feasibility/SKILL.md) | model | obtainability | Verify data obtainability, timing, coverage, licensing, alignment, missingness, and fitness for the estimand. Use when a research design depends on a dataset, API, archive, index, panel, event window, frequency, or merge whose real availability and semantics must be checked. |
| [`methodology-designer`](../skills/primitives/methodology-designer/SKILL.md) | model | alignment | Align research questions, estimands, constructs, data, models, assumptions, diagnostics, baselines, and evaluation. Use when designing an empirical or theoretical method, choosing among models, translating equations into estimable form, or checking that every hypothesis has an observable test. |
| [`falsification-first`](../skills/primitives/falsification-first/SKILL.md) | model | kill | Try to kill a research claim before reviewers do. Use when a hypothesis, mechanism, novelty claim, empirical design, or model needs falsifiers, rival explanations, placebo tests, negative controls, failure thresholds, or a predeclared kill-repair-continue rule. |
| [`pilot-study`](../skills/primitives/pilot-study/SKILL.md) | model | tracer study | Design the smallest end-to-end tracer study or interaction prototype that can expose feasibility, identification, representation, or usability failures. Use when a research idea needs a pilot, proof of concept, minimum viable dataset, preliminary estimation, questionnaire or coding-flow test, research-tool prototype, power reconnaissance, or go-no-go evidence before full execution. |
| [`research-review`](../skills/primitives/research-review/SKILL.md) | model | reject | Review research as a skeptical journal panel across contribution, theory, identification, measurement and data, evidence, and execution. Use when the user asks for peer review, referee comments, pre-submission audit, red-team review, major-revision risks, or an independent assessment of a paper, brief, model, or proposal. |
| [`research-diagnosis`](../skills/primitives/research-diagnosis/SKILL.md) | model | bottleneck | Diagnose a stalled, contradictory, or failing research project through a tight feedback loop. Use when results collapse, code and theory disagree, a reviewer attack cannot be repaired, a design keeps changing, a replication fails, or the team is doing more work without reducing uncertainty. |
| [`citation-audit`](../skills/primitives/citation-audit/SKILL.md) | model | entailment | Verify that citations exist, are primary where appropriate, and entail the claims they support. Use when auditing a manuscript, literature review, novelty claim, dataset statement, quotation, benchmark, reference list, or any draft where fabricated, stale, indirect, or overclaimed citations would be costly. |
| [`journal-fit`](../skills/primitives/journal-fit/SKILL.md) | model | audience | Match a research contribution, evidence standard, method, and narrative to a journal audience. Use when selecting target journals, comparing outlet fit, reverse-designing a submission, diagnosing desk-reject risk, or deciding whether a project is finance, economics, management, methods, or interdisciplinary work. |
| [`research-writing`](../skills/primitives/research-writing/SKILL.md) | model | argument | Write and revise evidence-led academic prose as a cumulative argument. Use for introductions, literature reviews, theory sections, methods, results, discussions, abstracts, reviewer responses, or finance and economics prose that must synthesize rather than list sources. |
| [`synthesize-research-brief`](../skills/primitives/synthesize-research-brief/SKILL.md) | model | collapse | Synthesize verified research state into one canonical Research Brief. Use when an adaptive research conversation has resolved enough question, evidence, contribution, theory, measurement, identification, data, method, and falsification state for downstream planning, proposal, or paper work. |
| [`render-research-deliverable`](../skills/primitives/render-research-deliverable/SKILL.md) | model | artifact contract | Render a verified Research Brief into a fit-for-purpose academic research plan, grant proposal, project proposal, paper blueprint, or manuscript draft. Use when the destination artifact is known and its claims, decisions, methods, and evidence must be assembled without inventing missing work. |
| [`ethics-reproducibility`](../skills/primitives/ethics-reproducibility/SKILL.md) | model | audit trail | Design ethical, reproducible, and auditable research. Use when a study involves human participants, personal or licensed data, model-assisted analysis, preregistration, provenance, computational reproducibility, conflicts of interest, disclosure, consent, or a replication package. |
